toeic_zh: 我們的差異化戰略專注於優質客戶服務。

en: to say publicly that you like and support a product
simple: A famous singer will endorse the shoes.
simple_zh: 一位知名歌手將為這雙鞋代言。
toeic: The company paid a famous athlete to endorse its new sports drink.
toeic_zh: 公司付錢請一位知名運動員為其新運動飲料代言。
family: endorsement (n) 代言；背書; endorser (n) 代言人; celebrity endorsement 名人代言

en: public support from a famous person for a product
simple: The singer gave the shoes an endorsement.
simple_zh: 那位歌手為這雙鞋代言。
toeic: A celebrity endorsement helped the new beverage reach younger customers.
toeic_zh: 名人代言幫助這款新飲料接觸到更年輕的顧客。

en: to carry out or perform an action
toeic: Our team executes daily marketing tasks efficiently.
toeic_zh: 我們的團隊有效地執行日常市場營銷任務。

en: combining two different types or methods
toeic: Our hybrid retail model combines online and offline channels.
toeic_zh: 我們的混合零售模式結合了在線和線下渠道。

en: To sell goods quickly, often at low prices.
simple: The shop must liquidate old stock.
simple_zh: 這家店必須變賣舊庫存。
toeic: The company had to liquidate its remaining inventory before closing.
toeic_zh: 公司在結束營業前必須變賣剩餘的庫存。

en: A small, specialized part of a market.
simple: They sell to a small niche.
simple_zh: 他們向一個小眾市場銷售。
toeic: The startup found a niche in eco-friendly office supplies.
toeic_zh: 這家新創公司在環保辦公用品領域找到了利基市場。

en: time needed to recover investment
toeic: The marketing campaign has a payback period of 6 months.
toeic_zh: 市場營銷活動的回本期限是6個月。

en: series of processes or customers in various stages
toeic: Our sales pipeline contains $5 million in qualified opportunities.
toeic_zh: 我們的銷售漏斗包含500萬美元的符合資格的機會。

en: plan or suggestion presented to someone
toeic: Our unique value proposition emphasizes quality and innovation.
toeic_zh: 我們獨特的價值主張強調質量和創新。

en: A fixed amount of sales a person must reach.
toeic: Our team exceeded its quarterly quota by fifteen percent.
toeic_zh: 我們團隊的季度業績超出配額百分之十五。

en: a short phrase that a company uses in its advertising
simple: The shop has a funny slogan.
simple_zh: 這家店有一句很有趣的口號。
toeic: The new slogan is short, catchy, and easy to remember.
toeic_zh: 這句新標語簡短、朗朗上口又容易記住。
family: advertising slogan 廣告標語; catchy slogan 朗朗上口的標語; campaign slogan 活動標語

en: level or point at which something begins
toeic: Orders exceeding the threshold receive automatic discounts.
toeic_zh: 超過門檻的訂單自動獲得折扣。

en: level or rank in a system
toeic: Our tiered pricing structure offers options for all budgets.
toeic_zh: 我們的分級定價結構為所有預算提供選項。

en: person or company that buys and sells goods or securities
simple_zh: 交易商做出了明智的決定。
toeic: The grain trader negotiated contracts for the harvest season.
toeic_zh: 穀物交易商為收穫季節談判合同。

en: To show a new product to the public for the first time.
simple: They will unveil a new car.
toeic: The company will unveil its latest smartphone at a press conference tomorrow.
toeic_zh: 該公司明天將在記者會上發表最新款智慧型手機。

en: selling goods in bulk at lower prices
toeic: Our wholesale division supplies 500 retail partners.
toeic_zh: 我們的批發部門為500家零售合作夥伴供應。

en: A group or agreement of partners who work together.
simple: The two firms formed an alliance.
toeic: The strategic alliance will help both companies enter new markets.
toeic_zh: 這項策略聯盟將協助兩家公司進入新市場。

en: Very valuable and important.
toeic: Please handle the precious artwork with great care.
toeic_zh: 請小心處理這件珍貴的藝術品。

en: to become three times as large
simple: Our sales will triple this year.
simple_zh: 我們今年的銷售額會成長三倍。
toeic: The company plans to triple its output by next year.
toeic_zh: 公司計劃明年將產量增為三倍。

en: to give up something for a greater purpose
simple: Parents sacrifice a lot for children.
toeic: We refuse to sacrifice quality to reduce costs.
toeic_zh: 我們拒絕為降低成本而犧牲品質。

en: brave and confident, or strong and clear
simple_zh: 她做了一個大膽的選擇。
toeic: The bold headline on the flyer attracted many customers.
toeic_zh: 傳單上醒目的標題吸引了許多顧客。

en: accepted by most people
toeic: Electric cars are now becoming mainstream in many markets.
toeic_zh: 電動車如今在許多市場已成為主流。

en: a wide range of different things
simple: The store sells a wide spectrum of goods.
simple_zh: 這家店賣各式各樣的商品。
toeic: The survey covered a broad spectrum of customer opinions.
toeic_zh: 這項調查涵蓋了廣泛的顧客意見。

en: stronger or more important than others
simple: It is the dominant company in the market.
simple_zh: 它是市場上佔優勢的公司。
toeic: The firm holds a dominant position in the online retail market.
toeic_zh: 該公司在線上零售市場佔有主導地位。

en: quick to learn or smart in ideas
toeic: The clever design reduced our packaging costs by half.
toeic_zh: 這個巧妙的設計使我們的包裝成本減半。

en: an official count of the people in a country
simple_zh: 人口普查會計算每一個人。
toeic: The census data helps us choose where to open new stores.
toeic_zh: 人口普查資料幫助我們選擇新店開設地點。

en: happening in many places or among many people
toeic: There is widespread support for the new return policy.
toeic_zh: 新的退貨政策獲得廣泛支持。

en: aware of something
simple: I was conscious of the noise.
toeic: Customers are more conscious of product safety these days.
toeic_zh: 現今顧客對產品安全更有意識。

en: completely new and very different
simple_zh: 這是一支革命性的手機。
toeic: The company introduced a revolutionary battery design this year.
toeic_zh: 公司今年推出了革命性的電池設計。

en: the strength or force of something
toeic: The intensity of competition in this market is rising.
toeic_zh: 這個市場的競爭強度正在上升。

en: the act of chasing or trying to achieve something
simple: He is in pursuit of a new job.
simple_zh: 他正在追求一份新工作。
toeic: The firm is in pursuit of new markets in Southeast Asia.
toeic_zh: 該公司正在東南亞尋求新市場。

en: a large and varied group of things
simple: The shop has an array of toys.
simple_zh: 這家店有各式各樣的玩具。
toeic: The store offers a wide array of products at low prices.
toeic_zh: 這家店以低價提供種類繁多的商品。

en: a widely held but false belief; an old story
toeic: It is a myth that online shopping is always cheaper.
toeic_zh: 認為網購一定比較便宜是個迷思。

en: small and not easy to notice
simple: There is a subtle difference in color.
toeic: The ad uses a subtle message to attract younger buyers.
toeic_zh: 這則廣告用含蓄的訊息吸引年輕買家。

en: without limits or control
simple_zh: 你可以在這裡自由發言。
toeic: Customers can freely choose from several payment options.
toeic_zh: 顧客可以自由選擇多種付款方式。

en: force or speed gained as something develops
simple: The team gained momentum this month.
simple_zh: 這個團隊本月氣勢越來越強。
toeic: The campaign is gaining momentum among young consumers.
toeic_zh: 這項活動在年輕消費者之間越來越有聲勢。

en: worth noticing because it is important
toeic: The report shows a notable rise in online orders.
toeic_zh: 報告顯示網路訂單有顯著增加。

en: thin; very small in amount
toeic: The chances of closing the deal are slim.
toeic_zh: 談成這筆交易的機會很渺茫。

en: the title of a news story
simple: I read the headline this morning.
simple_zh: 我今天早上看了頭條新聞。
toeic: The merger was the top headline in the business news.
toeic_zh: 這樁併購案是財經新聞的頭條。

en: accepting without taking action
simple: He is too passive at work.
toeic: A passive approach to sales will not bring new customers.
toeic_zh: 被動的銷售方式無法帶來新客戶。

en: a feeling or opinion about something
toeic: Consumer sentiment improved after the new law passed.
toeic_zh: 新法通過後，消費者信心有所改善。

en: a person or thing that does not win
simple: Nobody wants to be the loser.
toeic: Small shops may be the biggest losers if prices rise.
toeic_zh: 如果價格上漲，小店可能是最大的輸家。

en: especially; in a way that is easy to notice
simple: Many cities, notably Taipei, are crowded.
simple_zh: 許多城市，尤其是台北，都很擁擠。
toeic: Sales rose in several regions, notably in Asia.
toeic_zh: 多個地區的銷售額上升，尤其是亞洲。

en: clearly different from others and easy to recognize
simple: This cake has a distinctive taste.
simple_zh: 這個蛋糕有獨特的味道。
toeic: The company's distinctive logo makes its products easy to spot.
toeic_zh: 這間公司獨特的標誌讓產品很容易辨認。

en: rising or falling very quickly; too high in price
simple: The road is very steep here.
toeic: Customers complained about the steep rise in ticket prices.
toeic_zh: 顧客抱怨票價大幅上漲。

en: in a way that has no plan or pattern
toeic: Winners will be randomly selected from all entries.
toeic_zh: 得獎者將從所有參加者中隨機抽出。

en: a great success or victory
toeic: The product launch was a triumph for the marketing team.
toeic_zh: 產品上市對行銷團隊來說是一大成功。

en: very strong or aggressive
simple_zh: 那隻獅子看起來很兇猛。
toeic: The company faces fierce competition from overseas rivals.
toeic_zh: 該公司面臨來自海外對手的激烈競爭。

en: without any doubt
simple: He is undoubtedly the best player.
toeic: Our new model will undoubtedly attract younger customers.
toeic_zh: 我們的新款無疑會吸引更年輕的客群。

en: Related to the way someone acts
toeic: The company hired a behavioral expert to study customer habits.
toeic_zh: 公司聘請行為專家研究顧客習慣。

en: A group within a range, such as income level
simple: He is in a high tax bracket.
toeic: Customers in this age bracket spend the most on gadgets.
toeic_zh: 這個年齡層的顧客在小工具上花費最多。

en: Complete control of a market by one company
simple: One firm has a monopoly here.
simple_zh: 一家公司在這裡獨占市場。
toeic: The government broke up the telephone monopoly.
toeic_zh: 政府拆分了電話業的壟斷局面。

en: A position of power or control over others
simple_zh: 這家公司擁有市場優勢。
toeic: The brand maintained its dominance in the smartphone market.
toeic_zh: 該品牌在智慧型手機市場維持其主導地位。

en: To use something fully, often for gain
simple_zh: 我們必須利用這個機會。
toeic: The startup plans to exploit new opportunities in Asian markets.
toeic_zh: 這家新創公司打算開發亞洲市場的新機會。

en: A place or area where goods are bought and sold
toeic: Competition in the marketplace has become tougher.
toeic_zh: 市場上的競爭變得更激烈了。

en: To refuse to buy or use something as a protest
toeic: Many customers decided to boycott the brand after the scandal.
toeic_zh: 醜聞後許多顧客決定抵制該品牌。

en: To make a copy illegally, or to build with effort
simple: He tried to forge a signature.
toeic: The two firms worked to forge a strong partnership.
toeic_zh: 兩家公司努力建立穩固的合作夥伴關係。

en: To add something that makes another thing complete
simple: This wine will complement the meal.
toeic: The new software will complement our existing system.
toeic_zh: 新軟體將與我們現有的系統相輔相成。

en: In a surprising or very noticeable way
toeic: Sales grew remarkably well after the new campaign.
toeic_zh: 新活動後，銷售成長得非常好。

en: The quality of being easy to understand or use
simple: I like the simplicity of it.
toeic: The simplicity of the design makes the product easy to use.
toeic_zh: 設計的簡潔使產品容易使用。

en: Able to be known before it happens
toeic: Customer demand in this market is fairly predictable.
toeic_zh: 這個市場的顧客需求相當可預測。

en: the act of coming into view or existence
simple: The emergence of the sun was beautiful.
toeic: The emergence of online shopping has changed the retail industry.
toeic_zh: 網路購物的興起改變了零售業。

en: related to amounts and numbers
simple: We need quantitative data for the report.
toeic: The survey provides quantitative data on customer spending habits.
toeic_zh: 這份調查提供了顧客消費習慣的量化數據。

en: to get something back after losing it
simple: He wants to regain his strength.
toeic: The company hopes to regain its market share next year.
toeic_zh: 公司希望明年能重新奪回市占率。

en: to grow and do very well
simple: Plants thrive in this sunny room.
simple_zh: 植物在這間陽光充足的房間長得很好。
toeic: Small businesses can thrive if they offer excellent customer service.
toeic_zh: 小型企業若提供優質客服就能蓬勃發展。

en: financial support given to an event or person
toeic: Our company secured sponsorship for the annual charity concert.
toeic_zh: 我們公司為年度慈善音樂會取得了贊助。

en: not liked by many people
toeic: The new pricing policy was unpopular with long-term customers.
toeic_zh: 新的定價政策不受長期客戶歡迎。

en: toward the back or in reverse direction
toeic: Sales moved backward for the third quarter in a row.
toeic_zh: 銷售額連續第三季倒退。

en: something that makes a situation worse
simple: The small room is a disadvantage.
toeic: One disadvantage of this model is its high maintenance cost.
toeic_zh: 這款機型的一項缺點是維修成本高。

en: not busy or not tight
toeic: Business is slack during the winter months in the tourism industry.
toeic_zh: 旅遊業在冬季月份生意清淡。

en: to bring back to life or use
simple: Water will revive the dry flowers.
toeic: The company launched a campaign to revive interest in its brand.
toeic_zh: 公司推出活動來重振品牌的關注度。

en: to move or develop more slowly than others
simple: My little brother always lags behind.
toeic: Our sales continue to lag behind those of our main competitor.
toeic_zh: 我們的銷售持續落後主要競爭對手。

en: to attract someone with something pleasing
simple: Free food will lure many people.
simple_zh: 免費食物會吸引很多人。
toeic: Discounts are used to lure new customers to the store.
toeic_zh: 折扣被用來吸引新顧客到店。

en: in a way that relates to statistics
toeic: The difference between the two groups was statistically significant.
toeic_zh: 兩組之間的差異在統計上具有顯著性。

en: not producing the result you want
toeic: The advertising campaign proved ineffective at reaching young buyers.
toeic_zh: 這次廣告活動未能有效觸及年輕買家。

en: to encourage something to happen or grow
simple: Good grades spur me to study.
toeic: Lower interest rates may spur consumer spending.
toeic_zh: 較低的利率可能刺激消費支出。

en: to a very large degree
toeic: The new app has been hugely successful among young users.
toeic_zh: 這款新應用程式在年輕用戶中大獲成功。

en: to become larger or greater
toeic: The number of online orders will swell during the holidays.
toeic_zh: 假期期間線上訂單數量將會暴增。

en: to show or describe someone or something
simple: The painting will portray a farm.
simple_zh: 這幅畫會描繪一座農場。
toeic: The advertisement portrays the brand as modern and reliable.
toeic_zh: 這則廣告將品牌描繪成現代且可靠。

en: a rapid increase in number
simple: There is a proliferation of new shops.
toeic: The proliferation of smartphones changed how we shop.
toeic_zh: 智慧型手機的激增改變了我們購物的方式。

en: a group of firms that fix prices together
simple_zh: 石油卡特爾提高了價格。
toeic: The regulator fined the cartel for fixing prices.
toeic_zh: 監管機構因操縱價格而對該卡特爾處以罰款。

en: to make someone less willing to do something
toeic: High fees may discourage customers from using the service.
toeic_zh: 高額費用可能使顧客不願使用這項服務。

en: made to be thrown away after use
toeic: Disposable income rose by two percent last year.
toeic_zh: 去年可支配所得增加了百分之二。

en: a person who follows or supports someone
simple_zh: 她在網路上有很多追蹤者。
toeic: The brand gained ten thousand followers after the campaign.
toeic_zh: 這個品牌在宣傳活動後增加了一萬名追蹤者。

en: to persuade or cause something to happen
toeic: Discounts are used to induce customers to buy more.
toeic_zh: 折扣是用來誘使顧客買更多。

en: to grow well and be successful
toeic: Small businesses flourish in this part of the city.
toeic_zh: 小型企業在這個城區蓬勃發展。
